history.summary: A 570 sqft 1BR at $1,577 psf in a 613-unit Keppel/Wing Tai dev (TOP 2021), priced well below the $1,883 project median and the $1,864 avg of recent transactions. The flagship catalyst is the future Serangoon North CRL station 690m away, but a flat 1.12% URA CAGR shows the broader project has not appreciated since launch.
history.rating_rationale: Entry PSF $1,577 is ~16% below the $1,883 median and at the low end of the $1,593–2,079 psf range the project actually transacts at (avg $1,864) — a genuine discount, not an overpriced 1BR. 613 units and 209 txns mean deep liquidity. The 1.12% CAGR reflects the post-2021 cooling-measure plateau across the whole project, not a defect, and the under-priced entry plus CRL Serangoon North (~2030) at 690m give a clear forward catalyst. Reputable developer. Held back from Strong Buy by the flat recent trajectory and sub-$900k 1BR niche.
red_flags: 1.12%/yr URA CAGR — project has essentially gone sideways since 2021 TOP
1BR is a niche, investor-heavy segment competing with abundant D19 supply
CRL uplift is years out (~2030) and partly already in expectations
catalysts: Future CRL Serangoon North station 690m — strongest single catalyst in this 1BR group
Asking ~16% below project median and at the floor of the recent transacted range
Large reputable 613-unit Keppel Land/Wing Tai development with deep liquidity

history.summary: Genuinely cheap fresh-lease 1BR — asking PSF sits well below verified recent comps at a quality Keppel/Wing Tai project in OCR D19.
history.rating_rationale: This is the cleanest value case of the five: a comparable 614 sqft unit transacted at ~1801 psf (Nov 2025) and the project's last-12-month average is ~1864 psf, so a 570 sqft 1BR at 1577 psf is genuinely ~12-15% below market — directly corroborating the algo's -14.9% age and -12.4% cohort discounts with real recent resale evidence. It is OCR D19 (strongest forward region), built 2021 so ~94 years of lease remain, by reputable developers (Keppel Land + Wing Tai) with strong facilities. Verified cheap-vs-comps is the strongest robust forward signal under v3.4, and here it is decisive. Held back from Strong Buy / higher confidence by the thin 13-txn same-size cohort and the inherent weaker growth/liquidity of a 1BR, plus the very low 1.12% trailing CAGR (used only as neutral context, not a negative).
red_flags: Thin same-size cohort (psf_cohort_txns 13) — verify the specific unit's floor/facing isn't the reason for the discount before committing
Smallest 1BR type has structurally weaker capital appreciation and a shallower resale pool
Low 1.12% trailing CAGR signals limited price momentum to date (treated as story, not a forward negative)
catalysts: Verified ~12-15% discount to recent comps provides built-in margin of safety / re-rating room
OCR D19 region tailwind (~+4.0% realized forward) plus reputable-developer 2021 product with long lease
